title: The integer sequences — the OEIS core
body: The foundational integer sequences from the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences: the primes, Fibonacci, Catalan, the partitions, and thousands more — the low-numbered entries the whole of number theory keeps returning to. A spine of the Floor of Discovery at the scale of pure number.
